business_summary: Shinkin Central Bank operates as a central bank for Shinkin banks in Japan. The company provides various products and services, such as deposits, bonds, lending, market, settlement, trading operations, and trust services, as well as credit union operations. It is also involved in securities operations, regional trading company operations, overseas business support operations, consumer credit guarantee operations, and investment management operations, as well as M&A brokerage and data processing outsourcing. The company serves small and medium enterprises, individuals, and local communities. Shinkin Central Bank was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Shinkin Central Bank는 일본의 Shinkin 은행의 중앙 은행으로 운영됩니다. 회사는 신용협동조합업무를 비롯하여 예금, 채권, 대출, 시장, 결제, 매매업무, 신탁업무 등 다양한 상품과 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 증권업무, 지역상사 업무, 해외사업지원 업무, 소비자신용보증 업무, 투자관리업무, M&A 중개 및 정보처리 아웃소싱 업무도 담당하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 중소기업, 개인 및 지역 사회에 서비스를 제공합니다. 신킨중앙은행은 1950년에 설립되었으며 일본 주오에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
